description: Header file defining the V4L2ImageProcessorBackend class, which manages image processing accelerators using V4L2 memory-to-memory interface, including factory creation, processing methods, format support, and internal job management.

classes.name: V4L2ImageProcessorBackend
classes.description: Manages V4L2-based image processing accelerators, handling buffer queues, format reconfiguration, and job processing.

classes.name: JobRecord
classes.description: Represents a processing job with input/output frames and callbacks.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to instantiate the backend with specified configurations.

methods.name: Process
methods.description: Processes an input frame into an output frame asynchronously.

methods.name: ProcessLegacy
methods.description: Processes a frame using legacy callback method.

methods.name: IsSupported
methods.description: Checks if image processing is supported on the platform.

methods.name: TryOutputFormat
methods.description: Attempts to determine output size and plane count for given input/output formats and sizes.

methods.name: type
methods.description: Returns the type of the backend.
